release_notes.en-US: Reduces false warnings on legitimate Reddit links and rich link cards. Reddit's canonical, short, media, and deep-link hosts are recognized as related destinations, while unrelated app-link tenants and misleading visible-domain claims continue to be flagged. Adds broader automated and real-Firefox regression coverage.

version.approval_notes: Version 0.1.3 is a focused false-positive correction. It treats reddit.com, redd.it, and the reddit.app.link tenant as related destinations and limits single-domain mismatch checks to URL-like labels or short navigation cues, preventing domains mentioned in rich-card prose from being mistaken for claimed destinations. The app.link shared-hosting boundary remains tenant-specific, and adversarial suffixes such as redd.it.destination.test still warn. No permissions, data practices, network behavior, or remote services changed; analysis remains entirely on-device with declared data collection none. Validation covered 85 new Reddit/adversarial unit permutations, a 33-case dynamic browser fixture, and the supplied 150-case torture fixture in headless Firefox ESR 140. Mozilla lint reported no errors, warnings, or notices.
